# Asia Open: Supply Tightens, Prices Keep Rising  
**Bottom line:** Expect higher pricing pressure and maintain current order cadence; lock‑in only for parts flagged as “Lock pricing”.

## What changed
- Market supply risk holds at 69.8 (neutral change) while price trend nudges up to 84.2, confirming a “Rising” environment [1][2].  
- Fab utilization rose 1.8 points over the last three months, pushing supply tighter [4].  
- TSMC revenue growth (+50.9% YoY) signals strong foundry loading, adding to supply strain [3].  
- Semiconductor PPI (+9.1% annualized) continues to drive price pressure across all segments [1].  

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time **14 weeks** with **27,101** units in channel stock (≈17.6 weeks of coverage).  
- No on‑order quantity (PBO) disclosed; next arrival not announced.  
- Price **$5.56** for qty 1 and **$2.51** for 1 k units.  
- Origin **Austria**, tariff **0 %** (no surcharge).  
- Buy‑timing call: **Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)** – 65 % chance prices rise in 3 months but supply is adequate, so fix price now and keep normal ordering [9].


## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – supply 69.7 (↑0.1), price 82.4, confidence High.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – supply 70.2 (↓0.1), price 84.2, confidence High.  
- Analog & power management – supply 66.0 (↔), price 83.0, confidence High.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – supply 66.4 (↔), price 76.9, confidence High.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – supply 63.3 (↔), price 82.1, confidence High.  

## Your BOM watchlist
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – lead time 52 wks (norm ≈12 wks), supply risk 83.3 % (Elevated).  
- **LCMXO2-1200HC-4TG100C** – lead time 52.1 wks, supply risk 83.3 % (Elevated).  
- **XC7A35T-1CSG324C** – lead time 52 wks, supply risk 83.3 % (Elevated).  
- **IS25LP128-JBLE** – lead time 52 wks, supply risk 81.8 % (Elevated).  
- **MT25QL128ABA1EW9-0SIT** – lead time 52.1 wks, supply risk 81.5 % (Elevated).  

## Outlook
- Chip prices next 3 months: 66 % probability of rise, expected +2.17 % (80 % range –9.57 % to 13.91 %); model‑tested edge.  
- Chip prices next 6 months: 52 % probability of rise, expected +4.34 % (range –8.79 % to 17.46 %); baseline trend.  
- Fab utilization next 3 months: 63 % probability of tighter supply, expected +1.82 pts (range –1.71 to 5.36 pts); baseline trend.  
- Fab utilization next 6 months: 60 % probability of tighter supply, expected +3.64 pts (range –2.16 to 9.45 pts); baseline trend.  

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock‑in pricing** for parts on the “Lock pricing” list (e.g., IPB017N10N5ATMA1) to hedge the 65 % chance of price rise in three months.  
2. **Push for accelerated shipments** on the high‑risk watchlist items (52‑week lead times) – request partial early deliveries or safety‑stock agreements.  
3. **Leverage market data** (supply risk ≈70, price trend ≈84) to negotiate volume discounts or longer‑term contracts, emphasizing the sustained upward price pressure.
